title: Herbal Snappy Dutch Fish Papillote
description: A weeknight Dutch dish featuring fish cooked in a papillote with herbal flavors, perfect for a quick and healthy dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone mat.
Place a cod fillet in the center of each parchment paper sheet.
Drizzle the lemon juice and olive oil over the cod fillets.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley, dill, garlic powder, salt, and pepper over the cod fillets.
Fold the parchment paper over the cod fillets to create a papillote, making sure to seal the edges tightly.
Place the papillotes on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake the papillotes in the preheated oven for 12 minutes.
Remove the papillotes from the oven and let them rest for 2 minutes before serving.
